description: This file is a Zsh completion script for Git, providing command-line auto-completion functionalities for Git commands, options, and aliases in the Zsh shell environment.

methods.name: __gitcomp
methods.description: Provides completion for options starting with '--', handling special patterns and appending possible completions.

methods.name: __gitcomp_direct
methods.description: Provides completion directly from a list.

methods.name: __gitcomp_nl
methods.description: Provides completion from a list with a specified suffix.

methods.name: __gitcomp_file
methods.description: Provides filename completion from a list.

methods.name: _git_zsh
methods.description: Initializes the main completion for Git v1.1.

methods.name: __git_complete_command
methods.description: Invokes the specific completion function for a given Git command.

methods.name: __git_zsh_bash_func
methods.description: Handles command alias expansion and invokes the completion if available.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_common
methods.description: Provides a list of common Git commands with descriptions for completion.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_alias
methods.description: Provides a list of Git command aliases for completion.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_all
methods.description: Provides a list of all Git commands available for completion.

methods.name: __git_zsh_main
methods.description: Main function handling argument parsing and delegation to command-specific completions.

methods.name: _git
methods.description: Entry point for initiating the Git completion function in Zsh.
